input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets and in places exceeds our preferred position. Vendor warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards and material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications (19.1); Deliverables carry a ninety-day conformance warranty running from the later of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services must conform throughout the entire subscription term, which is better than the preferred twelve-month software period (19.2); and Vendor warrants no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality degradation, and no open-source contamination of Customer source code (19.3). The remedy in 19.4 is the full preferred ladder — prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item plus refund of Fees paid — and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. Acceptance mechanics in 6.1–6.2 provide a parallel correction-and-refund path. No redline needed.
